purpose: Human-operated keyboard-only QA across all public routes and the full assessment journey. Automated Puppeteer coverage in accessibility-automated-keyboard-supplement.json does NOT satisfy this row.

safeProcedure.summary: Local isolated preview with safe backend only — no production credentials, no live providers.
steps: Ensure TWILIO_*, SENDGRID_*, UPSTASH_*, GOOGLE_*, and ASSESSMENT_ROI_AGENT_LIVE_ENABLED are unset or unreachable
Start safe preview: bun run scripts/phase2/start-safe-assessment-preview.ts (or buildAssessmentBrowserServer({ safeBackend: true }) on http://127.0.0.1:3000)
Disconnect from production VPN/network paths to external CRM/SMS/email if applicable
Using only a physical keyboard (no automation, no Puppeteer/Playwright, no AI browser control), complete every check below
Record PASS or FAIL and notes for each check; attach completed file as accessibility-human-keyboard-owner-attestation.json
safeProcedure.safeEnvironment: buildAssessmentBrowserServer({ safeBackend: true }) — Redis stub, stripped credentials, no live SMS/call/email/CRM/webhook/analytics dispatch
